answer: Sybil resistance can use a terraced reward ladder: a new identity starts on the bottom terrace with tiny payouts, and each step up needs a locked bond plus clean audits by jurors from unrelated funding clusters. Like water finding karst cracks, clones leak toward cheap paths, so audits compare funders and merge matching clones into one share. A haven of bonded members stays profitable, while a thousand fakes pay a thousand bonds and earn one share.
